# Distro T2 SDE

T2 was the first distro to switch from `sox.sf.net` to `sox_ng`,
currently at 14.4.3.1 (2024-12-05).

## Links

* T2 SDE [package page for `sox`](http://t2sde.org/packages/sox)

## Patches

None required.

## TODO

See the notes at the bottom of [Distros] about build dependencies
and runtime recommendations.

You might also like to change the maintainer email
from sox_ng@proton.me to sox_ng@fastmail.com or sox-ng@groups.io
(the mailing list).

Proton was dumped because
* It is totally insecure because *they* send you the JavaScript you run
  every time you log into it, so it would take nothing for them to change it
  to send your every thought to the NSA as you type it,
  should those nice people ask in their usual persuasive and convincing manner.
* They seem to have bucketloads of money to throw away, according to their
  $millions of donations page, but at the same time they are always
  begging at the users, and if you register two accounts (sox and martin)
  and pay 50 quid for one, they won't let you download via IMAP with the other
  unless you give them another 50 quid. They seemed OK at first.

Thanks for the vote of confidence and for being the first distro on the ball.
